name: Verify Destiny WebUI
command:
set -euo pipefail; echo local_http:; curl -sS -o /tmp/destiny-health -w '%{http_code}\n' --max-time 15 http://destiny.whatbox.ca:12345/api/health || true; env_file="${UA_WHATBOX_ENV_FILE:-${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/upload-assistant/whatbox.env}"; set -a; source "$env_file"; set +a; export SSHPASS="$UA_WHATBOX_PASSWORD"; sshpass -e ssh -4 -o PubkeyAuthentication=no -o PreferredAuthentications=password -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes artemisprime@destiny.whatbox.ca bash -s <<'REMOTE'
set -u
sleep 10
cd ~/Upload-Assistant-wastaken
echo remote_state:
podman inspect upload-assistant-wastaken --format 'status={{.State.Status}} health={{if .State.Healthcheck}}{{.State.Healthcheck.Status}}{{else}}unavailable{{end}}' || true
echo remote_http:
code=$(curl -sS -o /tmp/ua-health -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 10 http://127.0.0.1:12345/api/health || true); echo "$code"
echo recent_logs:
podman logs --tail 12 upload-assistant-wastaken 2>&1 || true
REMOTE
description: Verify Destiny’s WebUI both locally and from the remote host after the restart.
